[[File:Power_socket.png|thumb|250px|R2-D2 attempts to hook into a power socket.]]
{{Quote|Don't look at me. I'm an interpreter, I'm not supposed to know a power socket from a computer terminal.|C-3PO to R2-D2|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''power socket''' was a device that allowed a piece of technology to connect to a power source, thus recharging it.

While hastening to leave [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] mistook a power socket for a [[computer terminal]], nearly frying himself in the process. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], however, disconnected the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] from the socket.
